content.comment_body: I'm trying to get my [product_name] to send data to AWS. I've followed tutorials and examples, and manage to establish a successful connection in [product_name] software, but the device does not show up in AWS IoT. I'm using the correct access key for my account credentials. [v8.3] [product_name] and [product_name] software.

Hello, Have you verified on the [product_name] device whether the cloud connection is working? Use Up/Down until you see the date and time. Then press ESC and navigate to the diagnostic menu, where you can check if the cloud connection and the AWS certificate are properly installed on your device. In the AWS console: did you select the correct server location? (You can change this in the top right corner of the console.) Hope this helps.
Thanks [user_name]. Changing the server location solved it – after switching to Frankfurt EU Central, my device appeared (AWS was previously set to Oregon by default).

analysis.insight_summary: A user tried connecting a [product_name] device to AWS IoT using [product_name] software. Even with a successful connection, the device was not visible in AWS IoT due to a mismatch in server region settings. This points to user confusion during integration between [company_name] software and AWS, especially when handling multiple cloud regions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects their device to be registered and visible in AWS IoT immediately after following setup steps and reaching a successful connection within the [company_name] software.
